title: One vehicle access point per lot (R40 and above)
text: In areas R40 and above, vehicle access points are limited to one per lot (refer Figure 3.7a) except where: i. an existing dwelling is being retained that has an established access point that is not able to serve the other dwellings; ii. dwellings front the street and access is not available from a communal street or rear right-of-way; or iii. the lot frontage exceeds 40m, two vehicle access points are permitted.

exceptions.label: (i) retained dwelling with an established access point
(ii) dwellings front the street and no communal street or rear ROW access
(iii) lot frontage exceeds 40 m: two access points

replaces.note: Part C applied the limit at R30+; draft R40 and above

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same test as Chapter 2 C3.7.2. Exception (i) 'not able to serve the other dwellings' and (ii) 'dwellings front the street' are not tested (no facts); the exceptions turn on retention and on the absence of a communal street or rear ROW. R30-R35 grouped dwellings lose the Part C one-access limit (not in the table of changes).

verified.note: Wording, R40 and above coding and the 40m / two access points limb confirmed. Exceptions (i) and (ii) state no effect; (i) 'not able to serve the other dwellings' and (ii) 'dwellings front the street' have no facts. Encoded as not applicable on retention / absence of a communal street or rear ROW.
